name: my-store
description: Example opencms project (implementation layer): content types, generated code and migrations

scripts.dev: opencms migrate:up && concurrently -k -n nest,next -c blue,magenta "tsx src/main.ts" "next dev -H 127.0.0.1 -p 3000"
scripts.start: opencms migrate:up && concurrently -k -n nest,next -c blue,magenta "node dist/src/main.js" "next start -H 127.0.0.1 -p 3000"
